status: Confirmed (MeowDB states it was measured/confirmed in COT2)
status_note: Close-range hit zones are the same in the first and second tests.
coordinate_convention: box_px = [left, top, right, bottom] in MapleStory px relative to the attacker's origin (feet), character FACING LEFT, y down (negative y = above the feet). Mirror x (x -> -x, swap left/right) when facing right. Some boxes extend behind the character (right > 0) or below the feet (bottom > 0); keep them as is.

hitzone_data_source.note: Bands: "ordinary" applies to character levels 1-99; "level100" replaces only the listed presentations from level 100. The White Knight "charge" band is omitted (MeowDB: never published).

reach_definitions: Horizontal reach is the distance from your character to the far edge of the hitbox.
Vertical reach is how far above your feet the hitbox goes.
Each value is the longest of that weapon's basic attacks, and the attack that reaches it is in brackets. Wands and staffs attack with Swing 2 only.
Values are for levels 1 to 99. From level 100, 2H Axes and 2H Blunt Weapons reach 110 px and Crossbows 88 px. 1H Swords, 1H Axes and Daggers then reach 72 px high, or 58 px for the 85 px group.

weapon_groups_note: basic_actions / final_attack_actions / not_used_actions follow the guide's card labels (Basic, Final Attack, Not used). unlabelled_actions are presentations present in the shared hit-zone set that MeowDB does not label for this weapon group (e.g. bows share the 2H-sword set but only the whacks and the crouched attack are listed as basic); do not treat them as usable basic attacks.
hitzone_family_naming_note: MeowDB's hit-zone family "wand" also covers One-Handed Blunt Weapon (they share the "mace" hit boxes). This is only a hit-box grouping: for damage, a One-Handed Blunt Weapon uses the 1H Axe / Blunt multipliers (swing 2.4, stab 1.2), not the wand physical 1.8 (Wooden Club item page confirms 2.4x / 1.2x).

ordinary_action_selection.rule: A normal attack with a sword, axe, blunt weapon, spear, polearm, or dagger swings 60% of the time and stabs 40%. At close range, a bow always swings and a crossbow splits 50/50.
ordinary_action_selection.presentation_odds_statement: A normal attack picks one of the attacks, each with equal odds (60% swing, 40% thrust), and the averages use those attacks. Crouched attack is left out of average calculations.
ordinary_action_selection.per_standing_presentation_applies_to: Each of the five standing basic presentations (three swings + two thrusts) is picked with equal odds, 5 x 20% = 60% swing / 40% thrust; the crouched attack is not part of this pool. Stated verbatim on the MeowDB weapon item pages checked here (Sword 541, Hand Axe 576, Wooden Club 585, Razor 558). Other melee families with a three-swing/two-thrust standing set (2H swords, 2H axes/blunts, spears/polearms) follow the same 60/40 rule on the weapon-reach guide; their item pages were not opened by this extractor.
ordinary_action_selection.pool_note: Consistent with the damage guide: "follows the current standing pool of three swing entries and two stab entries: 60% swing and 40% stab." (damage.json).
ordinary_action_selection.bare_hands: Barehanded ordinary attacks are 100% stab (damage.json ordinary_action_odds). Bare hands have no item page, and the split between Punch 1 and Punch 2 is not documented.
ordinary_action_selection.crouched: Crouched attack (proneStab) is a separate basic attack used while lying down; its damage uses the crouched branch in damage.json.
ordinary_action_selection.skills_note: Power Strike, Slash Blast, and the extra hit from Final Attack use the same 60/40 split as a normal attack.

lines: Hit when max(AttackLeft, MonsterLeft) < min(AttackRight, MonsterRight)
and max(AttackTop, MonsterTop) < min(AttackBottom, MonsterBottom)
Both boxes must share width and height. Touching at an edge does not count.
Weapon and monster artwork is ignored. Only the hitboxes count.

attack_ranges_px.three_snails_note: Three Snails reaches 300 px with any weapon. The Eye of Amazon and Keen Eyes do not extend it.

lines: Only basic ranged attacks and projectile skills check terrain. A blocked monster is dropped and its slot is not refilled.
Basic bow, crossbow and claw shots: Checked
Energy Bolt, Fire Arrow, Holy Arrow, Element Composition: Checked
Magic Claw, Slow, Cold Beam, Thunder Bolt, Ice Strike, Thunder Spear, Shining Ray, Doom: Ignored
Band of Thieves, Meso Explosion: Ignored
terrain_check.platform_rule: Shooting down through the platform you stand on is blocked. Shooting up through a platform is not.

statements: The target search begins 50 pixels ahead, checks 20 pixel bands, and widens by one pixel vertically for every four pixels horizontally.

svg_cross_check.description: Every hit box drawn on /guides/weapon-reach (SVG overlay, scale 2, attacker at x=470, feet at y=280) was converted back to px and looked up in the hit-zone JSON.

item_page_reach_cross_check.description: Each Beginner weapon item page lists every basic attack as "near- far px / up px" (Attack distance table). All values equal -left / -right (when right < 0) / -top of the matching hit-zone box.

gaps: Which of Punch 1 / Punch 2 a bare-handed attack plays (probabilities) is not documented (bare hands have no item page carrying the "equal odds" sentence).
Three Snails terrain interaction: its page says "Wall and platform interactions are not confirmed for this skill."
